description: This file contains utility functions for temporary file handling, locking mechanisms, and randomness, specifically in the context of Git reference table management. It includes functions for creating, closing, deleting, renaming temporary files, acquiring and releasing file locks, and generating random values.

classes.name: reftable_tmpfile
classes.description: Structure representing a temporary file used in reftable operations, including its path, file descriptor, and private data.

classes.name: reftable_flock
classes.description: Structure representing a file lock in reftable, including lock file descriptor, path, and private data.

methods.name: uint32_t reftable_rand(void)
methods.description: Generates a random 32-bit unsigned integer using a CSPRNG.

methods.name: int tmpfile_from_pattern(struct reftable_tmpfile * out,const char * pattern)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file based on a pattern and initializes a reftable_tmpfile structure.

methods.name: int tmpfile_close(struct reftable_tmpfile * t)
methods.description: Closes a temporary file, releasing resources.

methods.name: int tmpfile_delete(struct reftable_tmpfile * t)
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file and resets the reftable_tmpfile structure.

methods.name: int tmpfile_rename(struct reftable_tmpfile * t,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames a temporary file to a specified path.

methods.name: int flock_acquire(struct reftable_flock * l,const char * target_path,long timeout_ms)
methods.description: Acquires a file lock with a specified timeout.

methods.name: int flock_close(struct reftable_flock * l)
methods.description: Closes a file lock, releasing the lock file resources.

methods.name: int flock_release(struct reftable_flock * l)
methods.description: Releases a lock, rolling back and freeing lock resources.

methods.name: int flock_commit(struct reftable_flock * l)
methods.description: Commits a lock, finalizing the lock file update.
